risk_summary: The disclosure is detailed and substantially quantified, including liquidity, acquisitions, reserves, drilling plans, prices, and funding sources. Risk is tempered by acknowledged commodity-price volatility, dependence on borrowing and reserve values, declining net income, and reliance on projected development activity. Management expresses confidence that liquidity will be adequate for the next fiscal year, but several forward-looking statements remain conditional.
